pairs_needed.note: 7.28M unique matched pairs for 1 gov-day with no repeat (steps_per_day=181976, pairs_per_step=40 at K=10, batch=4)

encoded_disk_footprint.rail_status: TRIGGERED — pre-encode for any real corpus exceeds 100GB hard rail

option_b_streaming_cc3m.name: CC3M on-the-fly streaming
option_b_streaming_cc3m.note: Download CC3M metadata (~1GB: URLs+captions). Stream JPEG images from URLs at training time. Encode with corpus_patch_encode.encode_patches() (PIL+numpy, no GPU, ~1-3ms/image). Patches computed live, never written to disk.
option_b_streaming_cc3m.acquisition_verdict: EXTERNAL: CC3M metadata download (~1GB). Needs the maintainer authorization as external acquisition.

option_c_extend_b_multi_1.name: extend b-multi-1 local corpus
option_c_extend_b_multi_1.verdict: INSUFFICIENT — 500 pairs is 12 steps before cycling; no path to 7.28M

rationale: Encoder is pure PIL+numpy (no pretrained model, no GPU): patches = resize + crop + reshape, ~1-3ms/image CPU.
At 40 pairs/step and 380ms step time, encoder budget is ~9.5ms/pair — feasible in background DataLoader thread.
Pre-encode disk is 3.3TB for CC3M (100GB rail triggered). On-the-fly eliminates this entirely.
Only disk cost is CC3M metadata: ~1GB (URLs + captions), well under 100GB.
on_the_fly_vs_precompute.open_question: CC3M URL liveness (~80%): reduces effective pairs from 3.3M to ~2.6M = 0.36 unique days. Cycling 2.6M pairs covers 1-gov-day with ~2.8 repeats per pair. Acceptable for v0 pretrain (early epochs expect repeats).

rail_summary.external_acquisition: REQUIRES the maintainer AUTHORIZATION — CC3M metadata is external download not already on-machine
rail_summary.verdict: ESCALATE TO the maintainer before proceeding with any acquisition
